name: custom_bot
description: Example custom Telegram bot built only with generic PawFlow Telegram receive/send tasks. It checks an allowed user list from a flow parameter and handles a few simple commands.

bot_token.description: Telegram Bot API token from BotFather

allowed_users.description: Comma-separated Telegram user IDs allowed to use this bot. Empty means all users.

receive.label: Receive
receive.description: Receives or initiates the receive step using telegramReceiver.

handle_command.label: Handle Command
handle_command.description: Processes the handle command step using executeScript.

send_reply.label: Send Reply
send_reply.description: Delivers the send reply step using telegramSend.

stage_inputs.label: Inputs & triggers
stage_inputs.description: Receives requests and starts scheduled work.

stage_processing.label: Core processing
stage_processing.description: Performs the flow's main transformation or agent work.

stage_outputs.label: Delivery & outputs
stage_outputs.description: Publishes results and completes external responses.
